"""HTTP API for refunds (FastAPI)."""
from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, condecimal

from payments.db import session_scope
from payments.models import Payment
from payments.refunds import create_refund
from payments.errors import RefundError, InsufficientFunds

router = APIRouter(prefix='/v1/payments')


class RefundBody(BaseModel):
    amount: condecimal(gt=0, max_digits=12, decimal_places=2) | None = None
    reason: str = 'requested_by_customer'


@router.post('/{payment_id}/refunds', status_code=201)
def post_refund(payment_id: str, body: RefundBody):
    with session_scope() as session:
        payment = session.get(Payment, payment_id)
        if payment is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, 'payment not found')
        try:
            refund = create_refund(payment, amount=body.amount, reason=body.reason)
        except InsufficientFunds as exc:
            raise HTTPException(409, str(exc))
        except RefundError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(422, str(exc))
        # Any other exception (for example a KeyError) propagates and becomes HTTP 500.
        return {'id': refund.id, 'status': refund.status, 'amount': str(refund.amount)}

"""Payment and refund models (SQLAlchemy)."""
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum

from sqlalchemy import Column, DateTime, ForeignKey, Numeric, String, JSON
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship

from payments.db import Base


class RefundStatus(str, Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    FAILED = "failed"


class Payment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "payments"
    id = Column(String(32), primary_key=True)
    provider_ref = Column(String(64), nullable=False, index=True)
    status = Column(String(16), nullable=False)
    currency = Column(String(3), nullable=False)          # ISO 4217, always set at capture
    captured_amount = Column(Numeric(12, 2), nullable=False)
    metadata = Column(JSON, nullable=True)                  # free-form client metadata; may be empty
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)
    refunds = relationship("Refund", back_populates="payment", order_by="Refund.created_at")


class Refund(Base):
    __tablename__ = "refunds"
    id = Column(String(32), primary_key=True)
    payment_id = Column(String(32), ForeignKey("payments.id"), nullable=False)
    amount = Column(Numeric(12, 2), nullable=False)
    provider_ref = Column(String(64), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(16), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)
    payment = relationship("Payment", back_populates="refunds")

    @classmethod
    def record(cls, payment, amount, provider_ref, status):
        refund = cls(payment=payment, amount=amount, provider_ref=provider_ref, status=status.value)
        payment.refunds.append(refund)
        return refund
Payment.currency is always set at capture, while metadata is optional and may be empty.

"""Payment and refund models (SQLAlchemy)."""
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum

from sqlalchemy import Column, DateTime, ForeignKey, Numeric, String, JSON
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship

from payments.db import Base


class RefundStatus(str, Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    FAILED = "failed"


class Payment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "payments"
    id = Column(String(32), primary_key=True)
    provider_ref = Column(String(64), nullable=False, index=True)
    status = Column(String(16), nullable=False)
    currency = Column(String(3), nullable=False)          # ISO 4217, always set at capture
    captured_amount = Column(Numeric(12, 2), nullable=False)
    metadata = Column(JSON, nullable=True)                  # free-form client metadata; may be empty
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)
    refunds = relationship("Refund", back_populates="payment", order_by="Refund.created_at")


class Refund(Base):
    __tablename__ = "refunds"
    id = Column(String(32), primary_key=True)
    payment_id = Column(String(32), ForeignKey("payments.id"), nullable=False)
    amount = Column(Numeric(12, 2), nullable=False)
    provider_ref = Column(String(64), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(16), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)
    payment = relationship("Payment", back_populates="refunds")

    @classmethod
    def record(cls, payment, amount, provider_ref, status):
        refund = cls(payment=payment, amount=amount, provider_ref=provider_ref, status=status.value)
        payment.refunds.append(refund)
        return refund

"""Thin client for the card processor's refund API."""
import httpx

from payments.settings import PROVIDER_URL, PROVIDER_KEY


class ProviderClient:
    def __init__(self, base_url: str, key: str):
        self._http = httpx.Client(base_url=base_url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {key}'}, timeout=10)

    def refund(self, provider_ref: str, amount: str | None, reason: str, currency: str) -> dict:
        if not currency or len(currency) != 3:
            raise ValueError(f'invalid currency {currency!r}')
        body = {'payment': provider_ref, 'reason': reason, 'currency': currency}
        if amount is not None:
            body['amount'] = amount
        response = self._http.post('/v2/refunds', json=body)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

[KB-300] Return labels: prepaid return labels are valid for 30 days and accepted at every DHL ServicePoint and Packstation in Spain. The label is a PDF attached to the email; a printed copy or the QR code both work.

[KB-301] Replacement stock: when the replacement item is out of stock, offer the same model in another colour or a full refund; never substitute a different model without the customer's written agreement.

[KB-302] Express delivery in Spain: express parcels to mainland Spain arrive within 1-2 business days; the Balearic and Canary Islands take 3-5 business days. A signature is required for items above 150 EUR.

[KB-303] Gold tier: gold customers get priority handling and free returns on all orders, not only damaged ones.

[KB-304] Damage claims with the carrier: agents open the carrier claim themselves; the customer does not need to contact DHL. Claims do not delay the replacement.

[KB-305] Tracking: tracking numbers are sent in the dispatch email; agents may also share them in the conversation.

[KB-306] Address changes: the delivery address can be changed until the parcel is dispatched; after dispatch, redirect through the carrier's own service.

[KB-307] Business hours: the support team answers emails between 08:00 and 20:00 CET, Monday to Saturday.
